names.note: Read out of doxologia.ro's line for 16 iulie, «Sfântul Mucenic Faust», with the rank word left off.

death.note: doxologia.ro: «Sfântul Mucenic Faust (sec. III) a pătimit în timpul împăratului Deciu (249-251)». The interval is the reign the page prints; the page gives no year of its own.

attestations.note: Not checked: days.pravoslavie.ru for the corresponding Julian day (24 September 2026).

source.text: Calendarul zilei, Doxologia (doxologia.ro), 16 iulie — «Sfântul Mucenic Faust»

attestations.note: Not the Faustus the corpus already keeps on 31 august, who is one of the company of Andrew the Stratelates: that page places him under Maximian, this one under Decius, and doxologia keeps the two on different days.
